REPORT_TITLE: Quality Control Analysis of Recombinant Protein Batch AB-2025-Q4
AUTHOR: Dr. Jean-Pierre Martin, Ph.D.
EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY: This technical report presents a comprehensive quality control analysis of recombinant protein batch AB-2025-Q4, produced at the AntibodySystem facility in Paris, France. The analysis encompasses purity assessment, functional validation, and stability testing. All parameters met or exceeded the specified quality standards, with purity levels achieving 98.5% as determined by SDS-PAGE and SEC-HPLC analysis. The batch has been approved for release and distribution to research partners worldwide.
INTRODUCTION: Recombinant protein production requires stringent quality control measures to ensure consistency, purity, and functionality. This report documents the comprehensive analysis performed on batch AB-2025-Q4, consisting of monoclonal antibodies produced using our proprietary expression system.
BACKGROUND: AntibodySystem has established rigorous quality control protocols that align with international standards for biopharmaceutical production. Each batch undergoes multiple analytical tests to verify identity, purity, potency, and safety before release. This batch was produced using CHO cell expression systems with optimized culture conditions.
OBJECTIVE_1: Assess protein purity using multiple analytical techniques
OBJECTIVE_2: Validate biological activity and functional properties
OBJECTIVE_3: Evaluate batch-to-batch consistency and stability profile
METHODOLOGY: The quality control analysis employed a multi-tiered approach including SDS-PAGE electrophoresis, size-exclusion high-performance liquid chromatography (SEC-HPLC), ELISA-based potency assays, and accelerated stability testing under controlled temperature and humidity conditions. All methodologies followed validated standard operating procedures.
KEY_INFO: All analytical methods used in this study are validated according to ICH Q2(R1) guidelines and are routinely used for release testing of recombinant proteins at AntibodySystem.
RESULTS_ANALYSIS: The comprehensive analytical testing revealed exceptional quality parameters across all measured criteria. Purity analysis by SDS-PAGE showed a single dominant band at the expected molecular weight with minimal aggregation. SEC-HPLC confirmed monomeric content of 97.2% with negligible high molecular weight species.
CONCLUSION: Batch AB-2025-Q4 has successfully passed all quality control specifications and is approved for distribution. The high purity, excellent biological activity, and favorable stability profile confirm the robustness of our production process. This batch exemplifies AntibodySystem's commitment to delivering superior research-grade recombinant proteins to the scientific community.
